summary: GFL Environmental Inc. filed a Form 6-K with interim condensed consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing reports revenues of $1,947.8M and $3,591.6M for the respective periods, with a net loss from continuing operations attributable to GFL of $159.8M and $375.5M. It also includes discontinued operations and a call option gain, but no specific corporate transaction is announced. This is a routine periodic financial report by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event. No deal terms are disclosed.
